_comment: OVERSIZED CAME OUT 2026-09-08 AND NOTHING REPLACED IT, and this one was a real trade rather than a free win. A half-zip fleece is still sold today and the 2003 version was cut larger, so the word was doing period work -- but it was also the strongest volume word in the menu, and §74E found every subject rendering heavier than they are. The negatives cannot answer it back: this endpoint has no negative channel at all (§74D), so the 'fitted cut' below is inert. What carries the period now is what is left -- the half-zip, the marl grey, the stand collar, and the stonewashed straight-leg jeans underneath. REWORDED 2026-09-05 to name what is worn below it, so the frame is dressed to the ankle rather than leaving the model to invent the bottom half -- an unstated garment is the one place this menu was letting a modern silhouette in.
label: Zip-up fleece
wardrobe: a half-zip fleece pullover in marl grey, the zip pulled up to the collar, worn over a plain t-shirt with stonewashed straight-leg jeans
